general_rule.main: At base index i, h_i^0 depends on t_1..t_i and predicts t_(i+1).
general_rule.depth_k: h_i^k combines h_i^(k-1) with Emb(t_(i+k)), is processed by the causal MTP block, and predicts t_(i+k+1).
general_rule.causal_induction: Base hidden h_i^0 contains only t_<=i. With causal positions j<=i, depth k consumes t_(j+k)<=t_(i+k); therefore h_i^k contains at most t_<=i+k, while target is t_(i+k+1). The added input is earlier than its own target. Later-depth future-token inputs are absent from the main-core forward input. Sharing weights affects training gradients but does not insert future activations into that forward pass.

actual_depth_count.calculation: extra modules=D=1; extra future targets=D=1; total prediction positions including main=1+D=2. Thus the main predicts t_(i+1), the one extra predicts t_(i+2). Figure D=2 is explicitly a didactic variant.
actual_depth_count.expected: 1 extra module; next and next-next prediction
actual_depth_count.observed_by_hand: 1 extra module; next and next-next prediction

scope: 手算token對齊與結構計數，未執行神經網路、未訓練、未推定品質或GPU效果。字與〈B〉/〈E〉皆沿用課文的玩具token。
